title: krn lane run delivers the bootstrap first-test task on a vacuous contract and proves the test red on mutation
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114d slice 2: lane-run preflight (src/cli/lane-run/preflight.ts:151) and delivery (src/cli/lane-run/delivery.ts:100) refuse every vacuous contract, so the bootstrap task cannot run.
Outcome: in bootstrap state lane run admits only the seeded first-test task; delivery accepts it when the new test command runs >=1 test, goes red on a mutation of one production line and green on revert; then the bootstrap state is cleared and the contract is no longer vacuous.
Proof: task test against a real testless fixture clone (KRN-12) with a stub session writing a test; refusal stays for any other task.
